concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑012 (detect unseen atom/bond types and skip safely) is not addressed anywhere in the implementation plan. No task or script is described that logs warnings for novel atom/bond configurations or that skips such molecules during inference.

Functional Requirement FR‑015 (record solvent, temperature, and measurement‑method metadata alongside each FQY value) is absent from the plan. The preprocessing steps mention clipping and scaling but never specify capturing or storing experimental condition metadata.
